subject: POC: integration cadence delayed — request for extension & credits
messages:
From: Alicia Trent <alicia.trent@platformq.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-10T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: POC: integration cadence delayed — request for extension & credits

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick intro call this morning. We hit an unexpected blocker on our side: our SSO vendor pushed a mandatory schema change that broke our connector. The engineering team put a patch in but it requires an additional deployment window and a manual cert rotation from our identity provider.

Our original plan was to complete the connector and run the evaluation scripts this week, but that is now pushed out by at least two sprints (approx. 3–4 weeks). Because of that, we won't be able to generate the sample traffic for the POC within the original trial window.

Would Redwood consider extending our POC window by four weeks and adding a small pool of complimentary sandbox credits so we can complete the end-to-end run without hitting quota limits while we finish the SSO work? I attached a short excerpt from our logs for context (error-log-ssoconnect.txt).

We really like Redwood's performance profile and want to get this across the finish line — just need a bit of runway to validate metrics. Happy to jump on a call with your engineers if that helps.

Thanks,
Alicia Trent
Director of Platform
PlatformQ

--
Alicia Trent

Subject: Re: POC: integration cadence delayed — request for extension & credits

Hi Alicia — thanks for the note and for sending the log snippet. Sorry to hear about the SSO schema change; that kind of external dependency can be painful.

I've looped in Karthik from our engineering team and Marissa from CS so we can coordinate a practical remediation plan. Two quick asks so we can move this forward:
1) Karthik — can you confirm how much time we need on our side to re-run end-to-end checks once PlatformQ redeploys?
2) Marissa — can you prioritize this POC in CS queue and prepare a short mutual action plan we can share with PlatformQ (milestones + owner + dates)?

From a commercial perspective, I'm prepared to propose a four-week extension to the POC and an initial discretionary credit allocation (proposed placeholder: 25k tokens) while we confirm the exact compute needs. Will hold final credit allocation for Ben (commercial) to sign off after Karthik's estimate.

If PlatformQ can share a target deployment date (or the next maintenance window), we can align timelines. Happy to join any technical sync.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2027-07-12T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC: integration cadence delayed — request for extension & credits

Hi team — ran a quick assessment with PlatformQ's logs and the repo they sent over. Short summary: the schema change is isolated to the OIDC metadata parsing; it causes token validation failures under the current adapter but does not affect model-serving paths. Work required on our side:
- Update adapter to tolerate new metadata fields (3 business days)
- Add a one-off migration step for cached keys (1 business day)
- Validation run against PlatformQ staging with ~1000 concurrent sessions (2 business days)

If PlatformQ can schedule a deployment this week, our estimate to get to a green validation run is 6 business days from the time their deploy completes. Given some unknowns on their side, I recommend we plan for a 3-week extension to the POC to be safe.

Commercially, 25k sandbox tokens should be sufficient to cover validation traffic and a couple of full-run regressions. I've attached a short plan and a rough cost estimate (integration-plan.md, estimated-costs.xlsx).

If that scope changes after the validation run we'll re-calibrate, but this gives the sales/finance team something to approve now.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
